description: Super Clearance Sale The Boardwalk Rental Professional Grade Surrey-Double Bench Limo. You've seen them at leading resorts around the world, the Surrey Double Bench Quadricycle is lots of fun for the entire family. Looks like an antique car. Great for rental business, resorts, summer homes, or private communities. Features include a high quality tubular steel frame with reinforced welding, stainless steel fenders, bumpers and canopy uprights, rack and pinion steering, enclosed stainless steel chain-guard, Dual Disc Brakes, Dual tandem independent Pedal systems Four People can pedal, Dual Bench seat for up to four riders (actually you can have a small rider in between the two pedaling riders if you like) plus front rumble seat for small children. new for 2011. Rust Buster Brake Cables, Offset Cranks, Large bearing Sealed Crank Assembly, Double Steering Wheels, Internal Cable Routing,Middle Passenger footrests and more. Dimensions 42"wx72"lx69"h. Note- significant assembly is required. Ships Via truck.
